## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and linked to an issue when one exists.
- [ ] Tests cover the new behavior or the PR explains why no test applies.
- [ ] Documentation, changelog, and migration notes are updated where needed.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, customer payloads, private corpora, or model weights are included.
- [ ] Generated files were changed through their source and generator.
- [ ] Commits include a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] `./scripts/verify.sh` passes, or the exact remaining limitation is documented above.
